why: G641 (Jake, 2026-10-23): Night Market's 8 x 8 grid of 62.5 m tiles, layout B 'moat ring' (art/grid/round-50-night-market-tiles/03-layouts-board.jpg, 05-mockup-b-grid.jpg). Each row runs west to east (A..H), rows north to south (1..8); each tile is a letter (H house court, G garden, S stall row, C canal straight, L canal corner, N entry forecourt, P plaza quarter) and its rotation in quarter turns clockwise. Edit a letter or a digit; the generator rebuilds the plot.
